os.description: Target desktop operating system. Defaults to the current host OS and derives the native toolkit automatically.

arch.description: Target CPU architecture for the compiled native binary.

cpu.description: Target CPU instruction profile for ahead-of-time Rust codegen.

targetPlatform.description: Optional explicit native UI backend override (derived automatically from 'os' when omitted).

jsEngine.description: Optional embedded JavaScript engine override (defaults to 'jsc' on Linux/macOS and 'quickjs' on Windows).

outputPath.description: Optional output directory override (defaults to 'dist/<projectName>' inherited from architect.build).

main.description: Optional main entrypoint override (inherited from architect.build.options.browser).

version.description: Application release version propagated to runtime config and OS installers.

permissions.description: Build-time static capability analysis policy and manual allow/deny overrides.

mode.description: 'auto' infers capabilities from AST usage + overrides; 'strict' grants only 'allow'.

deny.description: Capabilities explicitly revoked even if detected in source files.

packageFormats.description: Distribution package formats emitted by the native packager.
